name: Azeroth Companion
title: Source Studio — Official Spell Media & Comparative Research
features: Optional on-demand Blizzard spell media icons through a validated and region-scoped /api/spell-media route; missing images fall back gracefully.
Side-by-side talent rank comparison includes returned spell/talent IDs, text descriptions, and manually allocated rank counts.
Two-item lookup comparison includes returned item levels, equipment fields and numeric stat differences where both records supply values.
Original Talent Forge and all v5.3 pan/zoom/mini-map controls retained, with the same compact 4-bundle frontend footprint.
No invented spell artwork, simulated damage, automated build legality or best-in-slot ranking is asserted.
Cloudflare worker-v5.4-spell-media-reference.js is included for optional backend deployment; the release itself does not change the live Worker.
